sources.title: SYCL 2020 specification
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: OpenMP Target：資料映射的生命週期
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件DAG、臨界路徑轉移與存活證明；17/13正確，C絕不早於兩前驅完成且資料存活至最後消費；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver event DAGs, critical-path transitions and lifetime evidence. Verify 17/13, C starts after both predecessors, and data survives its final consumer. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫主機變數、裝置映射、更新點與解除映射；明定to/from方向而非假設雙向同步；320/16帳目清楚，最後回傳與所有中間更新皆列入。
related.differenceEn: Draw host variables, device mappings, updates, and unmapping. State explicit to/from directions. Verify 320/16 while accounting for final retrieval and every intermediate update.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 獨立A與B完成後才做C，理想T=max(TA,TB)+TC；不同佇列不自動消除資料相依；合成A=8、B=12、C=5毫秒；變更B=6，其他不變且資源可平行；名義式 12+5 = 17 ms critical path；變更式 8+5 = 13 ms critical path。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
每輪搬入搬出共D bytes，k輪重複映射流量kD；合法持續映射只有首入末出D；合成D=16MB，k=20；比較外層持續映射，輸入中途不由主機更改；名義式 20*(8+8) = 320 MB transferred；變更式 8+8 = 16 MB transferred。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Independent A/B precede C, so ideal T=max(TA, TB)+TC; separate queues do not remove dependencies. Synthetic A 8, B 12, C 5 ms; change B 6 with independent resources. Nominal 12+5 = 17 ms critical path; changed 8+5 = 13 ms critical path. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

If round-trip traffic is D bytes, k repeated mappings cost kD, while legal persistent mapping costs D. Synthetic D 16 MB, k 20; compare outer persistent mapping with no intermediate host modifications. Nominal 20*(8+8) = 320 MB transferred; changed 8+8 = 16 MB transferred. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ExBLAS 思維：歸約順序與可重現總和
related.titleEn: ExBLAS principles: reduction order and reproducible sums
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件DAG、臨界路徑轉移與存活證明；17/13正確，C絕不早於兩前驅完成且資料存活至最後消費；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver event DAGs, critical-path transitions and lifetime evidence. Verify 17/13, C starts after both predecessors, and data survives its final consumer. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫左結合與先相消兩棵樹，另列精確整數參考；不要把整數AST驗算當FP64模擬；精確1/2參考成立，浮點實驗另記型別、順序與誤差，不混稱精確。
related.differenceEn: Draw left-associated and cancellation-first trees. The cancellation-first arithmetic checks provide references; they do not simulate every FP64 operation. Exact references 1 and 2 must match. Record type, order, and error separately for floating-point experiments.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 獨立A與B完成後才做C，理想T=max(TA,TB)+TC；不同佇列不自動消除資料相依；合成A=8、B=12、C=5毫秒；變更B=6，其他不變且資源可平行；名義式 12+5 = 17 ms critical path；變更式 8+5 = 13 ms critical path。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

真實數加法可結合，但有限精度每次加法會捨入；測試應保留輸入順序與精確參考；合成十進位整數[10^16,1,−10^16]，精確總和1；變更中間值2後精確總和2；名義式 (10**16-10**16)+1 = 1 exact integer reference sum；變更式 (10**16-10**16)+2 = 2 exact integer reference sum。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Independent A/B precede C, so ideal T=max(TA, TB)+TC; separate queues do not remove dependencies. Synthetic A 8, B 12, C 5 ms; change B 6 with independent resources. Nominal 12+5 = 17 ms critical path; changed 8+5 = 13 ms critical path. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Real addition is associative, but finite-precision operations round each step. Retain input order and an independent exact reference. Synthetic integers [10^16, 1, −10^16] sum exactly to 1. Changing the middle value to 2 gives an exact sum of 2. Nominal (10**16-10**16)+1 = 1 exact integer reference sum; changed (10**16-10**16)+2 = 2 exact integer reference sum. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
